card.name: Partway through compound adjectives
card.fires_on: The last piece of a hyphenated or split adjective-like term, such as blood-b|orne, postdoctor|al, retros|pective and water-sol|uble. It also fires on 'Student' after 'Graduate' and on 'state' in 'solid-state'.

modes.label: Ending of split adjectives
modes.description: The closing piece of a long adjective that is split into parts, often right before a noun.
modes.example: Pen-sharing poses a risk for transmission of blood-b<<orne>> pathogens.

modes.label: Academic title and field terms
modes.description: Pieces of academic role or technical terms such as postdoctoral or graduate student.
